sam-support: FYI customer reported embeddings suddenly doubled in length after we canaried a pinned variant this morning. They see 1536 -> 3072.
meera: which customer? any request ids?
sam-support: cust_acme via support ticket. Request id `req_0a1b2c`. Sample response:
sam-support: ```json
{ "model": "openembed-legacy-pinned:2.1.0", "embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ...] }
```
alex: do we have model catalog mapping for that pinned tag? openembed has multiple archs. :thinking_face:
meera: checked routing: policy fallback allowed `openembed-xlarge` when `openembed-legacy-pinned` missing capacity. That xlarge has 3072 dims.
sam-support: problematic because customer persisted vector dimension 1536 in DB. Their index fail:
meera: logs show kernel selection moved to xla-opt and variant id `openembed-xlarge-fp16`. stack trace:
meera: ```
ERROR ingestion: vector length mismatch: expected 1536, got 3072 (req=req_0a1b2c)
```
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout `openembed-legacy-pinned` -> `openembed-legacy-pinned:2.2.0` completed at 2026-03-17T09:12:23Z
alex: likely sequence: pinned model version rolled, capacity short, policy routed to xlarge fallback, client sees xlarge embeddings. We'll need to ensure model variant compatibility or enforce dimension check at routing.
sam-support: customer wants rollback or a compatibility shim. They have 180GB data, can't reindex quickly.
meera: short repro steps:
meera: 1) curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"openembed-legacy-pinned","input":"hello"}'
meera: 2) check `embedding.length`
meera: 3) force routing to `openembed-legacy-pinned:2.1.0` with `variant=locked` to confirm behavior.
sam-support: asked for logs and sample vector; gave them a mitigation: add pre-flight check to reject mismatched dims by error (client-side) while we fix routing rule.
alex: I'll open infra ticket to disable fallback routing for pinned variants and add a post-deploy check for embedding_dim delta > 0. Also adding metric `embed.dim_changes` alert.
meera: assigning: ENG-1234 (routing policy), INF-5678 (post-deploy checks). I'll notify customer and propose either rollback or transient adapter to downsample xlarge embeddings to 1536 (lossy).
sam-support: thanks. I'll keep cust updated. :thumbsup:
